subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw add a provider/model-specific recovery path for vLLM gpt-oss streams, or require an exact current-main stream fixture before changing executable tool-call promotion?
rationale: The issue is credible and user-impacting, but the reduced current source path appears to handle reasoning-first native tool_calls, and recovery policy can affect the provider-output-to-tool-execution boundary.

options.title: Require exact fixture first
options.body: Keep this issue open until the failing current-main SSE stream or live vLLM reproduction is captured, then use that fixture to choose a narrow parser fix.

options.title: Accept vLLM-specific recovery
options.body: Authorize a tightly gated vLLM/gpt-oss recovery path if maintainers are comfortable with provider-specific executable tool-call repair from the existing report evidence.

options.title: Fold into no-finish work
options.body: Treat the remaining work as covered only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98124 or its successor proves this exact reasoning-first `finish_reason: tool_calls` failure too.

recommendation.title: Require exact fixture first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the failing current-main SSE stream or live vLLM reproduction is captured, then use that fixture to choose a narrow parser fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and adjacent merged-provider-stream history make this the best available owner for the policy decision.
